title: Streamstein shared media / transcript / spiral-search schema
description: Field-for-field analogue of Readstein's Book + SearchIndexMeta + SearchIndexSection + DatedWork, retargeted from books to videos and their VTT/SRT transcripts. Fields marked x-status=verified mirror live Readstein or StreamStein desktop source; x-status=proposed are design decisions awaiting sign-off. See docs/SPIRAL-SEARCH-COMPATIBILITY.md.

MediaFormat.description: First six verified from StreamStein's VIDEO_EXTS (src/ipc/youtubeLibrary.js:23); HLS proposed for streams. Readstein's analogue is BookFormat.

hash.description: Partial md5 of the media file. Same algorithm and role as Book.hash; also the on-disk directory name (Media/<hash>/).

metaHash.description: Hash of the metadata, used to aggregate different versions of the same work (re-encodes, quality variants, re-downloads).

sourceTitle.description: Title parsed at import; StreamStein falls back to fileName / basename when the catalog has no title.

channelName.description: The creator. Plays the role of Book.author.

libraryChannel.description: Local folder-derived channel label used for shelf grouping. Plays the role of Book.groupName.

durationMs.x-note: Catalog stores durationSeconds; normalize to ms to match the tMs locator.

publishedAt.description: Drives the spiral year ring. NOT present in the desktop catalog today; acquisition (YouTube API / TMDB) is an open task.

completedAt.x-note: Year-ring fallback when publishedAt is absent.

transcriptPath.description: Located by dir + stripWindowsDuplicateBasename(basename) key. Null when no transcript was downloaded.

videoId.x-note: External id (YouTube). Identity for the app stays `hash`.

SearchIndexSection.description: One searchable chunk. For books this is a spine section; for videos it is a chunk of transcript cues labelled by chapter or mm:ss.

startMs.x-note: First cue's start time in this chunk; the video analogue of a section's first CFI.

cueIdx.x-note: Index of the first cue inside the chunk.

SearchIndexMeta.description: Header row of a work's search.db. Versioned so stale caches rebuild; navHash tracks structural freshness separately from text freshness.

navHash.description: For books: hash of the TOC. For videos: hash of the chapter list / transcript revision.

SearchLocator.description: The video analogue of a CFI: a stable cursor that can be resolved to a seek position. Resolving is a separate step from matching, exactly as resolveSearchResultCfi() is on the Readstein side.

charStart.x-note: Offset of the match inside section text, so the excerpt can be re-highlighted.

SearchConfig.description: Must mean identical things in both apps or the dial lies. Mirrors readest:LibrarySearchConfig (types/book.ts:543); note modeToWholeWords/ensureSearchMode legacy-boolean derivation must be replicated exactly.

target.x-note: works/transcripts for Streamstein; books/text are Readstein's names for the same distinction.

YearBand.description: Fixed-width slice of the timeline. Bands are equal in years by construction; slicing where the data falls makes the ring's sort order read wrong.

DatedWork.description: One dated component of one work. The dial plots components, not works — a work with three dated parts occupies three places on the ring.

workId.description: MediaItem.hash, or Book.hash for the book side.

part.description: For videos: the chapter/section within the work.

SpiralSearchEvent.description: Streaming result event. Results arrive as an async generator so the dial fills out live; nothing may block until the whole library is scanned.
